scams.name: Bali Ngurah Rai Airport (DPS) Fake-Grab & Taxi Mafia
scams.description: Bali's Ngurah Rai Airport has the most-documented 2025 airport-taxi scam ecosystem in Indonesia. r/bali 'Grab scams at the airport?' (comments/1hpfieg, 2025) documents the pattern: 'There are a few exceptions like Japan, Singapore but more often then not they are trying to scam you' — meaning the airport taxi queue itself is run by a 'taxi mafia' that blocks Grab/Gojek from pickups inside the terminal perimeter and quotes 'fixed prices' 2–4x the legitimate app rate. r/BaliTravelTips 'I ran into the Bali Taxi Mafia — here's what actually happened' (comments/1onardi, 2025) is a named 2025 first-person anchor: 'They had signs in their hands with Grab on them and aggressively asking Grab sir, Grab baby and' — meaning scammers hold Grab-branded signs INSIDE the arrivals hall to fool tourists. r/bali 'Are taxi scams common in Bali?' (comments/15r1dcz) gives the Vietnam-parallel answer: 'Yes. They overcharge tourists by a lot. Use Grab. There are also many scams around the temples.' r/BaliTravelTips 'Worst experience of my life with the taxi mafia in padang bai' (comments/1mljock, 2025) documents the cross-island pattern where legitimate Grab drivers are forced by local mafia to transfer tourists to higher-priced local drivers at ferry ports. The legitimate fare from DPS to Kuta is 60,000–100,000 IDR (~$4–$6 USD) via Grab/Gojek app; to Seminyak 80K–140K; to Ubud 300K–400K (1-hour drive). Unofficial 'fixed prices' quoted by airport touts run 250K–500K for Kuta, 600K–1M for Ubud. For older travellers arriving in Bali, the practical defence: (1) walk OUT of the arrivals hall and cross to the designated Grab/Gojek pickup zone (signposted, ~50m from terminal exit) — drivers are NOT allowed inside; (2) book Grab or Gojek yourself on airport Wi-Fi AFTER luggage — verify licence plate matches app; (3) ignore any 'Grab' sign-holder inside the terminal — all are unauthorised; (4) for the Ubud transfer, pre-book via Klook at 250K–350K IDR or ask your hotel for a free transfer (many include it); (5) NEVER let a 'friendly local' walk you to a 'cheaper taxi' — this is the Padang Bai pattern adapted to the airport.
scams.avoidance: Walk OUT to the designated Grab/Gojek pickup zone ~50m from terminal exit Book Grab/Gojek on airport Wi-Fi AFTER luggage; verify licence plate Typical fare: 60K–100K IDR DPS-Kuta, 80K–140K Seminyak, 300K–400K Ubud For Ubud, pre-book Klook transfer 250K–350K IDR or use hotel free pickup IGNORE every 'Grab' sign-holder inside the arrivals hall
scams.location: Ngurah Rai International Airport (DPS) arrivals hall, official Grab/Gojek pickup point (50m walk from terminal), Kuta-area drop-off zones

scams.name: Bali ATM Skimmer Fraud & Card Cloning
scams.description: Bali has one of Asia's most-documented 2025 ATM-skimming problems. r/bali 'Card skimming' (comments/1hqajly, 2025) is a named 2025 first-person anchor: 'Just had to freeze our wise cards, got cash out of an ATM near Uluwatu. Not even 20 minutes later, my card had been' cloned and used. r/bali 'ATM Skimming $2000' (comments/1gsd3w5, 2025) documents a specific 2025 $2,000 AUD loss where the bank traced the skim to a specific ATM location. r/bali 'Got card skimmed' (comments/1m7eqxu, 2025) confirms the ongoing 2025 pattern: 'Card skimming is very common in Bali if you go on google you'll see reviews saying that.' r/bali 'Cards skimmed in Bali' (comments/1hosyuu, 2025) documents a related variant: 'I get Fraud alert on my cards. I paid cash. My cards were in my wallet within reach whilst I was get' ting a massage — meaning cards sitting in a wallet at a spa or hotel room can be cloned remotely via RFID skimmers, not just physical ATM skimmers. The specific ATM scam patterns: (1) physical card-reader overlay on non-bank ATMs that captures magnetic stripe data; (2) pinhole camera capturing PIN entry above the keypad; (3) 'cash trap' where money is held back mechanically and claimed 'dispensed' by the bank's records; (4) RFID-skimmer variants that clone contactless cards at close range. For older travellers, the practical defence: (1) use ONLY ATMs INSIDE bank branches during business hours (BCA, Mandiri, BNI, BRI) — never freestanding convenience-store ATMs; (2) cover the keypad with your other hand when entering PIN; (3) inspect the card slot for loose overlays before inserting (wiggle it — real slots don't move); (4) use a RFID-blocking wallet or sleeve for contactless cards; (5) set low daily withdrawal limits and transaction alerts on your bank app; (6) withdraw larger amounts less frequently rather than small amounts often; (7) if skimmed, file a police report with Polda Bali (+62 361 227 274) within 24 hours for credit card chargeback documentation.
scams.avoidance: Use ONLY bank-branch ATMs during business hours (BCA, Mandiri, BNI, BRI) Cover keypad with your other hand when entering PIN Wiggle the card slot before inserting — real slots don't move Use RFID-blocking wallet for contactless cards Set low daily withdrawal limits and transaction alerts on your bank app
scams.location: Free-standing ATMs at tourist areas (Kuta, Seminyak, Uluwatu, Ubud), non-bank-branch ATMs in convenience stores, hotel-lobby ATMs without CCTV

scams.name: Money Changer Sleight-of-Hand & 'Best Rate' Trap
scams.description: Bali's money-changer scam is so well-documented that it has its own 2025 PSA thread. r/bali 'SCAM ALERT in Bali – Please Read Before Exchanging' (comments/1r80hy6, 2025) is a named 2025 anchor: 'This scam has been going on since tourism started in Bali… Like decades. The higher the exchange ra' te advertised, the more sleight-of-hand is used during counting. r/BaliTravelTips 'SCAM ALERT in Bali – Please Read Before Exchanging' (comments/1r80gx8, 2025) is the cross-posted 2025 variant. r/bali 'Bali money exchange scam - they got me!' (comments/1jqc372, 2025) is another 2025 first-person anchor: 'Went just outside Ubud and popped into a money exchange. So many red flags, I should have known, but' the rate was too good to resist. The scam mechanics: (1) advertised rate is 200–500 IDR per USD HIGHER than the real market rate (bait); (2) changer counts out stacks of 50K or 100K notes quickly in Indonesian numerals while hiding part of the stack; (3) when tourists count their own stack, it's 10–30% short; (4) if challenged, changer re-counts while palming notes back; (5) changer argues the calculation to confuse; (6) some changers intermix torn or expired notes into the stack. Typical loss: 500K–3M IDR ($30–$200) per transaction. For older travellers, the practical defence: (1) use ONLY authorised PT. Central Kuta Money Exchange (bright blue/white branding, numerous locations, transparent glass counting) or PVA ASSOCIATE money changers with the proper authorisation sticker from Bank Indonesia; (2) reject any 'BEST RATE' stall — rates 100+ IDR above Google rate are a scam; (3) count the full stack YOURSELF before leaving the counter; (4) bring a calculator and do the math in front of the changer; (5) never exchange more than $200 at once; (6) alternative: use a BCA, Mandiri, or CIMB Niaga ATM to withdraw IDR directly from your home-country card at the interbank rate.
scams.avoidance: Use ONLY PT. Central Kuta Money Exchange (blue/white branding) or Bank Indonesia-authorised PVA Reject 'BEST RATE' stalls — rates above market are the scam bait Count the full stack YOURSELF before leaving the counter Bring your own calculator and do the math in front of the changer Alternative: ATM withdrawal at BCA, Mandiri, or CIMB Niaga bank branches for interbank rate
scams.location: Independent money changer stalls with 'BEST RATE' signs (Kuta, Legian, Ubud centre, Seminyak), beachfront changers in tourist strips

scams.name: Scooter Rental 'Spare Key Theft' & Pre-Damage Claim Scam
scams.description: Bali's scooter-rental economy runs on a 300K–500K IDR/week model — but has two documented scam variants. r/bali 'scooter scams and horror stories' (comments/3qj44o) is the canonical community anchor for the 'spare key theft' pattern: 'To rent a scooter, have it followed. Then when you arent looking, they use a second key to steal it' back, then demand payment for the 'stolen' scooter from the renter. r/bali 'Renting scooters' (comments/1i9xty3, 2025) is a named 2025 anchor confirming: 'Yes there are scams. One is they rent you the scooter then steal it with spare key and then you have' to pay 10–25 million IDR ($700–$1700) for a replacement. The second variant is pre-existing-damage-claim: the rental shop photographs the scooter in specific angles that don't reveal scratches, hands it to the renter, and at return claims the scratches as new damage demanding 500K–2M IDR. r/bali 'Did we get scammed?' (comments/1p0x8kv, 2025) documents a related 2025 rental-damage variant. r/bali 'Fair deal or rip off?' (comments/1ixrqu8, 2025) captures the pricing baseline: 1.4M IDR/month is 'fair,' 50-80K IDR/day is typical daily. For older travellers considering a scooter (IMPORTANT: scooter driving in Bali requires confidence in heavy traffic and a valid international driving permit with motorcycle class — most older travellers should skip scooter rental entirely and use Grab/GoCar), the protective playbook: (1) rent ONLY from community-vetted shops: Bali Scooter Rental, Rental Scooter Ubud, Jaya Bike Rentals — each with Google reviews mentioning 'no damage scam' outcomes; (2) video a walk-around narrating all visible scratches BEFORE leaving; (3) photograph the scooter, the keys (to verify only ONE key handed over), and your licence exchange; (4) NEVER leave passport as deposit — cash deposit maximum 500K IDR; (5) wear a helmet (legally required; refusing to wear one creates bribe leverage for police); (6) if the scooter is 'stolen' during the rental, call Polda Bali immediately (+62 361 227 274) — the report documents legitimate theft for insurance.
scams.avoidance: For older travellers: SKIP scooter rental entirely; use Grab/GoCar Rent only from community-vetted shops (Bali Scooter Rental, Rental Scooter Ubud, Jaya Bike Rentals) Video walk-around narrating scratches BEFORE leaving Verify BOTH keys are handed over; photograph them NEVER leave passport as deposit — cash only (max 500K IDR)
scams.location: Kuta, Legian, Canggu, Ubud scooter rental shops; hotel-doorstep scooter rentals; street-corner rental stands with no paperwork

scams.name: Traffic Police 'Bribe Shakedown' for Scooter Riders
scams.description: Bali's traffic police have a long-documented pattern of stopping tourist scooter riders for 'violations' (no international driving permit, no helmet, wrong road, expired tax) and demanding an on-the-spot 'fine' payable in cash with no receipt. r/bali 'Got stopped by traffic police in Kuta, had to bribe 200k' (comments/9kftx7) is a canonical community anchor: 'police station, its idr 150,000. Either way you won't be contributing to Bali's corruption.' r/bali 'I had my first shake down today' (comments/tzu4tg) documents the veteran response: 'The cops are corrupt af but also you should've known better. Wear helmet and get an IDP so you don't' give them leverage. r/bali 'Are Bali police beginning to stop all foreigners to check for' (comments/1khppbn, 2025) is a named 2025 anchor capturing the recent escalation: 'In my day it was pretty much just a bribe checkpoint. 50k IDR was more than enough to get through wi' thout incident. The 2025 escalation is more systematic — some checkpoints now process 20–30 tourists per morning, typically demanding 200K–500K IDR per stop. The scam mechanics: (1) checkpoint set up on known tourist routes (Jalan Raya Kuta, Jalan Sunset Road, near Tanah Lot); (2) police officer waves scooter to pull over; (3) officer cites violation (helmet angle, passport not in hand, 'wrong lane'); (4) officer quotes 1M–2M IDR 'official fine'; (5) officer 'sympathetically' suggests 200K–500K 'pay here' alternative as 'faster'; (6) some officers photograph your passport and licence before returning them, creating data-harvest risk. For older travellers (who should not be riding scooters in Bali anyway), the defensive rules: (1) get an International Driving Permit WITH motorcycle endorsement before travel — not having one is the single most common excuse; (2) wear helmet and ensure passenger wears one too; (3) keep passport + IDP in waterproof bag on body; (4) if stopped, insist on paying the 'official fine' at the police station (about 150K IDR); officers lose interest when cash-in-hand isn't the outcome; (5) do NOT escalate or argue — stay calm and professional; (6) if you're riding pillion with a local Grab driver, you're not at risk — the scam targets self-drive tourist riders.
scams.avoidance: Get International Driving Permit WITH motorcycle endorsement before travel Wear helmet (including passenger); keep passport + IDP in body-worn waterproof bag If stopped, INSIST on paying 'official fine' at police station (~150K IDR) Stay calm; do not escalate or argue Use Grab/GoRide for older travellers — you're not a target as a passenger
scams.location: Kuta, Legian, Seminyak police checkpoints targeting tourist scooter riders; morning and late-evening enforcement windows

scams.name: 'Tourist Levy' / Bali Tourist Tax Confusion & Scam Sites
scams.description: Indonesia introduced a legitimate 150,000 IDR (~$10) Bali Tourism Levy in February 2024 — but the implementation has generated widespread 2025 confusion and a specific scam ecosystem. r/bali 'Treasure Bali - Tourist Tax Scam' (comments/1kz72a5, 2025) is a named 2025 anchor documenting fake-website clones of the official Love Bali portal (lovebali.baliprov.go.id) that charge 3–5x the legitimate 150K IDR and produce non-functional confirmation codes. r/bali 'Final Conclusion - Bali Tourist Taxi Levy Thingy' (comments/1h3wegq, 2025) captures the community's frustration: 'Don't pay for it, its a bit of a scam imo. I paid for the visa and that's it. Bali is already not do' ing enough to justify the new fee. r/user 'Bali Tourist Traps to Skip in 2025' (comments/1lku991, 2025) documents the broader 2025 tourist-trap context: 'Expensive parking, queues, vendors, and sometimes scams (like mandatory guides). Instead: Check ou' t the official sites only. The scam patterns: (1) Google ads for 'Bali tourist levy' lead to clone sites charging 750K–1.5M IDR (5–10x legitimate); (2) airport 'levy collection' touts near immigration demanding cash for an 'uncollected' tax; (3) hotel concierge charging 'tourism partnership fee' at 2–3x; (4) tour operator 'levy included' packages that actually charge double. For older travellers, the defensive playbook: (1) pay ONLY at the official site lovebali.baliprov.go.id (the extension .baliprov.go.id indicates official Bali provincial government); (2) legitimate fee is 150,000 IDR / ~$10 USD per person, one-time per visit; (3) pay BEFORE travel (QR code on phone) OR at the airport green-jacketed counter AFTER immigration; (4) IGNORE any Google ads for 'Bali tourism levy' — go direct to the URL; (5) refuse any 'airport tax' demand above 150K IDR; (6) the payment is one-time only — NOT per hotel night, per tour, or per day. r/bali 'Love Bali Website - did anyone have problems paying?' (comments referenced in the 2025 thread) documents the legitimate-site UX issues that fake sites exploit.
scams.avoidance: Pay ONLY at lovebali.baliprov.go.id (official Bali provincial government domain) Legitimate fee: 150,000 IDR (~$10 USD) per person, ONE-TIME per visit Pay BEFORE travel (QR code on phone) OR at airport green-jacketed counter post-immigration IGNORE Google ads for 'Bali tourism levy' — type URL manually REFUSE any 'tax' demand above 150K IDR; the fee is NOT per night or per day
scams.location: Online — fake Love Bali / Tourism Levy payment sites, airport 'tax collection' touts, hotel-partner 'tourism fee' collection

scams.name: Organised Drink Spiking at Bali Beach Clubs & Nightlife
scams.description: Bali has a 2025 documented escalation in organised drink spiking targeting female tourists at beach clubs and nightlife venues. r/TwoXChromosomes 'Warning for women in Bali… organised drink spiking at' (comments/1p9euy3, 2025) is a named 2025 first-person anchor: 'What I witnessed around us was organised, it looked coordinated. A group of three foreign men were g' roup-drugging tourist women at a named venue. r/BaliTravelTips 'Warning for women in Bali… organised drink spiking at' (comments/1p9ew6x, 2025) is the cross-posted 2025 warning. r/BaliTravelTips 'A warning about drink spiking in Indonesia' (comments/1sps78j, 2025) captures the 2025 broader pattern. r/bali 'WARNING: Drinks spiked with Scopolamine in Gili T' (comments/ctzojb) documents the scopolamine variant: 'It kills hundreds every year in Indonesia, including some in Bali and the Gilis. It is legal to dist' ribute. Scopolamine is a deliriant that renders victims compliant and unable to recall events — commonly used in Latin American scams but documented in Bali and Gili nightlife since at least 2018. The specific 2025 patterns: (1) coordinated group of foreign men at Seminyak/Canggu beach clubs identifying solo or small-group female tourists; (2) drinks spiked in exchange moments (returning from bathroom, dancing); (3) victim becomes cooperative and compliant rather than incapacitated — removed from venue to hotel or elsewhere; (4) robbery, sexual assault, or both follow; (5) memory blackout typical. For older travellers and all solo female travellers, the defensive playbook: (1) NEVER leave a drink unattended — not even for 30 seconds; (2) order bottled drinks where possible and open them yourself (beer from unopened bottle is safest); (3) at beach clubs, stay with trusted companions and set buddy check-in times; (4) refuse drinks you didn't personally order from the bartender; (5) if you feel unexpectedly disoriented, ask bar staff for help IMMEDIATELY — reputable Bali venues have trained protocols; (6) notify Polda Bali (+62 361 227 274) immediately if spiking suspected; (7) stay at hotels with proper security staff and taxi-desks rather than hostels or budget villas; (8) consider Ubud (calmer, yoga/retreat focused) over Kuta/Canggu for older traveller itineraries.
scams.avoidance: NEVER leave a drink unattended — even for 30 seconds Order bottled drinks where possible and open them yourself Stay with trusted companions; set buddy check-in times at beach clubs Refuse drinks you didn't personally order from bartender If disoriented, ask bar staff IMMEDIATELY; call Polda Bali (+62 361 227 274)
scams.location: Kuta and Legian nightlife strip bars, Seminyak beach clubs (Potato Head, Finns), Canggu beach bars, Gili Islands nightclub cross-reference
